text: LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton SE has been listed on Euronext Paris for over thirty years. It is controlled by the Arnault family, which is consolidating its stake into a single holding company, Agache SCA (replacing Christian Dior SE), to hold 49.76% of LVMH's share capital and 65.55% of its voting rights once a 2026 restructuring completes.

source.name: Bloomberg, via Business Standard: 'Arnault tightens control on LVMH with simpler holding structure'
source.quote: control over LVMH would thus be exercised within a single company, listed on Euronext Paris for over thirty years
